events.description: Spun out of follow-up batch 2026-05-20 alongside camera / Litharch / Worker fixes. User picked the 'full deterministic state' option over the minimal-snapshot variant; user also picked 'spin out as a deft task' over inline implementation, so this file replaces the disabled Save / Load menu items as the persistent record of the work.

Web HUD + IMGUI menu stubs already wired in commit 06f536f: Settings / Save / Load show 'coming soon' notifications instead of silent-closing. SaveLoad UI in Menu.jsx is marked disabled:true. When this task implements Phase 3, those flags flip back and the new SaveLoad overlay takes over.
